description: Human variant–disease relationships supported by ClinVar clinical assertions and/or GWAS lead-variant associations from the Open Targets Platform. Allele-specific supporting evidence is retained in separate parallel lists for each source.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Evidence sources supporting the relationship: OpenTargets_ClinVar and/or OpenTargets_GWAS.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the relationship was created or its properties last changed.

source_contributions.scope: Germline and somatic ClinVar assertions with at least one clinical significance other than "not provided"; no review-status filter. Only assertions linked to a Disease represented in SPOKE are included.
source_contributions.description: Clinical assertions connecting human variants to diseases, including benign, uncertain and conflicting classifications. Each evidence entry represents one assertion row for a resolved Disease.

properties.name: ot_clinvar_rcv_ids
properties.description: ClinVar RCV assertion identifiers.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_clinvar_variant_ids
properties.description: The specific variant allele for each supporting entry.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry. "NA" for rows without variantId (resolved by rsID)

properties.name: ot_clinvar_clinical_significances
properties.description: Clinical significance classifications, excluding "not provided".
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry. Fields that are themselves multi-valued within one entry are stored as one string with values joined by "|", in source order.

properties.name: ot_clinvar_review_status
properties.description: ClinVar assertion review status.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry. "NA"

properties.name: ot_clinvar_allele_origins
properties.description: Allele origins reported for the assertion.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry. Fields that are themselves multi-valued within one entry are stored as one string with values joined by "|", in source order. "NA"

properties.name: ot_clinvar_datasets
properties.description: ClinVar dataset: germline or somatic.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_clinvar_ot_disease_ids
properties.description: Open Targets disease identifier for each supporting entry, expressed as a CURIE.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_clinvar_disease_mappings
properties.description: Disease correspondence category: direct_mondo, direct_doid, via_OMIM, via_Orphanet, via_MESH, or via_UMLS.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_clinvar_scores
properties.description: Open Targets ClinVar evidence scores.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry. NaN

properties.name: ot_clinvar_directions_on_trait
properties.description: Direction on the trait: risk or protect.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry. "NA"

properties.name: ot_clinvar_allelic_requirements
properties.description: Allelic requirements reported for the assertion.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry. Fields that are themselves multi-valued within one entry are stored as one string with values joined by "|", in source order. "NA"

properties.name: ot_clinvar_pubmed_ids
properties.description: Supporting PubMed identifiers.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry. Fields that are themselves multi-valued within one entry are stored as one string with values joined by "|", in source order. "NA"

properties.name: ot_clinvar_n_assertions
properties.description: Number of distinct ClinVar RCV assertion identifiers.
properties.notes: 0 when ClinVar does not support the edge

properties.name: ot_clinvar_mean_score
properties.description: Mean Open Targets ClinVar evidence score, ignoring NaN.
properties.notes: Omitted when ClinVar does not support the edge or all scores are NaN

source_contributions.scope: Only lead variants of Open Targets GWAS credible sets; no p-value threshold. Non-lead credible-set members are excluded. Only associations linked to a Disease represented in SPOKE are included.
source_contributions.description: GWAS lead-variant associations with diseases. Each evidence entry represents one credible set and one Open Targets disease identifier for the resolved Disease.

properties.name: ot_gwas_study_locus_ids

properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_gwas_variant_ids

properties.name: ot_gwas_p_values

properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry. "NA"
